lowpass — ONED signal op

• Data kinds: signal → signal

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.lowpass(x, rate, cutoff, order=4) (to call the implementation directly, import dsp; dsp.lowpass(x, rate, cutoff, order=4); from the registry, ops1d.get("lowpass"))

Usage

Butterworth low-pass (scipy, zero-phase filtfilt). *cutoff* must be inside `(0, rate/2)`; an out-of-Nyquist cutoff raises instead of passing the signal through. A signal too short for zero-phase filtfilt also raises (the message names the exact minimum) instead of silently coming back unfiltered.
